idea: Position the speaker as a misunderstood advocate for community-police communication.
hook: Charged with obstruction of justice, but I wasn’t trying to interfere—I was trying to help.
title: Bridging the Gap: Community Voices and Justice
script: Charged with obstruction of justice. So they said I was trying to run a parallel investigation, which I wasn't. I was trying to get people to get them information, because, you know, nobody wants to talk to the cops. They don't get involved. But they come and tell me things, and then I tell them.
caption: When people are scared to talk to the police, they share their concerns with me instead. My intention has always been to foster trust and communication. There's so much more happening beneath the surface. Let’s change the narrative together.

caption:
Feeling like your day is already full? You’re not alone. The key is to find small pockets—10 or 15 minutes here and there—that add up. Use tools like a timer or calendar reminders. Even short, focused sessions can build real momentum. Write down what you want to create, then commit to one quick task daily. It’s about consistent, doable steps.

For a simple plan on building digital products in small time chunks, check the free guide linked in bio.
